title: Mother’s Day
simplified_paragraphs: 今天是母亲节。 早上， 女儿和儿子对妈妈说： “ 妈妈， 母亲节快乐。 我们爱你！ ” 妈妈笑了。 女儿给妈妈买了一件衣服， 儿子给妈妈买了花， 这些都是妈妈喜欢的东西， 妈妈非常高兴。
traditional_paragraphs: 今天是母親節。 早上， 女兒和兒子對媽媽說： “ 媽媽， 母親節快樂。 我們愛你！ ” 媽媽笑了。 女兒給媽媽買了一件衣服， 兒子給媽媽買了花， 這些都是媽媽喜歡的東西， 媽媽非常高興。
pinyin_paragraphs: jīn tiān shì Mǔ qīn jié。  zǎo shang，  nǚ ér hé ér zi duì mā ma shuō：“  mā ma，  Mǔ qīn jié kuài lè。  wǒ men ài nǐ！”  mā ma xiào le。  nǚ ér gěi mā ma mǎi le yī jiàn yī fu，  ér zi gěi mā ma mǎi le huā，  zhè xiē dōu shì mā ma xǐ huan de dōng xi，  mā ma fēi cháng gāo xìng。
english_paragraphs: Today is Mother's Day. In the morning, the daughter and son said to their mother: "Mom, happy Mother's Day. We love you!" Mom smiled. The daughter bought a dress for her mother, and her son bought flowers for her mother. These are all things that her mother likes, and her mother is very happy.
english_full: Today is Mother's Day. In the morning, the daughter and son said to their mother: "Mom, happy Mother's Day. We love you!" Mom smiled. The daughter bought a dress for her mother, and her son bought flowers for her mother. These are all things that her mother likes, and her mother is very happy.
